steps.content: The luminous spikes of the shackles pierce through the creature's core, and in an instant, the colossal monster falls apart. Yet the air still reeks of its stench and an oppressive aura of despair.
You scan the surrounding chaos, in search of any sign of Vautour Bleu, when a small hand grabs the hem of your clothes.
Liam grips your clothes tightly, staring at Désir with a blank expression. The once peaceful, vibrant town now lies charred in ruins.
The streets are littered with debris, and the alleys once adorned with colorful flower pots are now scorched and lifeless.
The town square's fountain stands bone-dry, its basin now a reservoir of viscous monster slime.
The townsfolk, unable to process the sudden catastrophe, stagger in the wreckage. Emotionally drained, they can only stare at the rubble around them.

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: You're... the one from DisCity...
A local you've rescued recognizes you. Those dull, lifeless eyes brighten briefly before going out again.

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: Mess
Though the immediate threat has passed, the townsfolk do not seem to rejoice, but instead look weary and lost.
Alba, who always wore a bright smile, has now lost all her lively colors. Her pallid face bears only streaks of dried tears.

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: DisCity... it's impossible now... It was all a lie...

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: All the dieting... all the starving... it was for nothing...
She murmurs, clutching her stomach as a dry heave racks her. But nothing comes from her retching, her body too depleted to even respond.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: Who can we trust now? If we can't go to DisCity, where do we go?

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: Désir... it's in ruins. It's over. Everything is over.
As their gaze falls upon you and the soldiers, no one speaks. They simply stare, as if you were apparitions from another realm, alien and intangible.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Is it over now? Is Désir gonna be destroyed? I... I have no home to go to...
No, DisCity isn't here to destroy. We've come to take you to the Drifter Camp, where you can start a new life.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Drifter Camp? What's that?
Liam looks up, his eyes meeting yours with confusion, as if slowly waking from a long nightmare.
It's a settlement in DisCity's West District. Not long ago, they survived a Mania disaster even worse than yours. The Black Ring nearly took their entire home.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: That doesn't sound good.
You're right. To be honest, DisCity is far from good.
Life in the Drifter Camp might not be as comfortable as here in Désir. It's a noisy place, railcars constantly zipping between buildings, and the vendors don't even give you what you pay for...
But they survived the disaster. They're rebuilding it, their home, bit by bit.
The food at the Grand Stall is actually pretty good. Sure, you'll run into some hotheads or greedy sellers, but most of the people there are friendly.
They're all just folks who'd run out of options and had nowhere to go—just like you.
But they've transformed the Drifter Camp with their own hands. Not relying on anyone, they fight off contamination and turn the rusty shacks into a fortress, a living community.
Liam's eyes light up, and then he sees the group behind you.
Reinforcements from the Outland Affairs Bureau and the MBCC have arrived, along with a massive sand ship, large enough for evacuating the entire population of the town.

steps.speaker: That way it would match my hair and clothes, don't you think?
steps.content: You're from DisCity. Can we really trust you?
That I can't decide for you. But I can tell you one thing though: The bread you make, Primrose, it'll be love wherever you go.

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: ...Can we really go there? That Drifter Camp place?

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: If this DisCity pal says we can go, then we're good to go!
A spark of life returns to their dull eyes. The dying embers of their old dreams reignite, kindling a new flame of hope that spreads among the townsfolk.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Will there be other friends my age there?

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: Is it far away? I'm running low on cash...

Excitement sweeps across the townsfolk. They're like castaways at sea spotting a ship on the horizon. Where this ship is headed doesn't matter—any destination is better than the vast, frigid ocean of sands.
The questions from townsfolk pour in about the Drifter Camp. People crowd around you, like they once did with Vautour Bleu.
Through the shifting sea of people, you finally catch a glimpse of the familiar silhouette...
[Small CG Farewell 1]
She appears unscathed, her posture as proud as ever. Tucked away in an inconspicuous corner, she seems content, looking genuinely happy that everyone has found a new glimmer of hope.
Vautour Bleu watches the townsfolk from afar, eyes brimming with gentle warmth and unspoken blessings.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Go easy on the booze when you get to DisCity, Juan, or you'll soon go broke before you know it.
If he pawns his dagger for a drink again, she won't be able to buy it back for him any more.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Alba, you're such a sweet girl with a sweet tooth.
In her eyes, Alba has always been the prettiest girl in Désir.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Primrose, you can make your way in the world with your skills, no matter where you go.
It's a shame she'll likely never taste it again.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Liam, one day you'll grow into a promising young man.
Take your time, take your time... until one day he's ready to face the truth that Mom is long gone.
As she reminisces her time with everyone, Vautour Bleu takes a step back, then another. She turns around and walks alone into the shadow of the town.
If dreams are destined to fade, then just keep having more.
[Small CG Farewell 2]

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Carry on what I couldn't. Keep their unfulfilled dreams safe in the oasis for me.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Next time you open your window, I won't be there anymore.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Au revoir, my little neighbor.
Her steps falter, but her demeanor remains serene. The remaining monsters still linger in the dark, their grotesque forms faintly visible in the shadows.
She's heading back to her chamber, but this time, her neighbor won't be joining her.
You both walk away, paths diverging, a final parting in silence.
I have one last question, about our deal.
Why are you doing all this?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Do you know how I decide who should stay in Désir?
Vautour Bleu taps her smoking pipe as if trying to tap off the ash of her past. As the embers fade, only wisps of smoke linger in the air.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I can tell with just a single glance. No one knows better than I do what kind of person can survive on the strength of dreams.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Preserving dreams before they fall apart... that's my own sweet fantasy.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Just so you know. This place... is my oasis, too.

Rumors about the disappearance of Désir circulate among the bazaars of WhiteSands. Some say a disaster devoured the oasis; others believe that DisCity's patience ran thin, leading the FAC to purge the town's shady trafficking business.
A woman leans against the cargo ship, staying away from the bustling market gossip. In her hands is a letter bearing a familiar postmark.
It is the same mark from that confidential recording from DisCity.

steps.speaker: Letter
steps.content: Désir's Mania crisis resolved. The "deal" is over.

She's never interested in dealing with the big families of the Outlands. With the deal concluded, there's no need to keep any proof. She lights the envelope with her pipe, watching that emblem of the northwestern noble family blacken into ash.
Her caravan crew stands ready with several refugees waiting to board. She gives them a nod.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Kids heading to DisCity again? Let them tag along. We're merchants, after all. No reason to turn down good business.
As long as there's a need, Désir will always exist.
It might be known by other names—the Chief from DisCity or the Drifter Camp, or simply, hope, which will always live on.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Allons-y. Time to move on to our next Désir.
The caravan sets off from the rest station, fading into the boundless WhiteSands.
